releases.displayName: Big new content update + Japanese language! + NPLH is out on Switch!

items.text: We have some exciting news to share with you today! Not one, not two, but three announcements! There’s lots to share, so without further ado, let’s jump straight into it. Enjoy!
But before we go there here is a quick off-topic announcement we hope you will enjoy!

Our newest game, Pan'orama, just released! It's a puzzle game in which you create beautiful landscapes with hex-shaped tiles, complete objectives to earn points and discover unique structures with abilities that shape the environment around them!

notes.title: What you can you do in Pan'orama

items.text: relax and unwind while creating beautiful worlds out of hex-shaped tiles
sculpt unique biomes by placing tiles of the same type next to each other
place tiles in specific places around objectives to get extra points
test your skills and creativity while aiming for a high score
unleash your imagination in creative mode with a variety of creator tools
interact with cute animals that pop up all around
Go ahead and dive into it, relax and unleash your creativity like never before and build the most stunning Pan’oramas ever!

notes.title: No Place Like Home is out on Nintendo Switch!

items.text: In addition to the new patch, we have some more exciting news to share with you! No Place Like Home is now available on the Nintendo Switch thanks to our partnership with Merge Games!

Not only that, you can purchase it in both digital and physical formats. The digital version is already available, so you can grab it from the eShop! And if you prefer to have a physical copy to add to your collection, you can pre-order it today and it will be shipped to you as soon as it's released (planned release is summer 2023). So whether you're at home or on the go, you can now enjoy all the fun and creativity of No Place Like Home on your Switch!
皆さん、こんにちは！

Starting today, a new language option has been added to the game - the Japanese language! If you notice any errors or mistranslations, please let us know, we'll be happy to verify and correct any errors.
よろしくお願いします。
From adorable flower pots with animals peeking out, to a new language option, to a giant pig zeppelin, this update has it all! Here's what's been added in today's patch:
Perfect for binge-watching all your favorite shows (if your imagination allows it) while pretending you're not avoiding your responsibilities in the post apocalyptic world.

There are lots of stylish new patterns to choose from, including simple designs, subtle florals, and even some cute animal prints. Whether you want to make a statement or keep it understated, there's a wallpaper to suit every taste.

But wait, there's more and it’s pretty quack-tastic. We’ve added a giant duck for all of you oversized, cute animal fans! That's right, now you can have a rubber friend that's almost as big as your house. It's up to you to find it and feed it as much rubber as you can!

For those of you who prefer your decor to be a bit more airborne, we've added a pig-zeppelin. That's right, a floating pig! There’s also a new, oinktastic pig-zeppelin-themed cap for your animals to wear while they attend their funky parties.
LNext one is a swing decor item. Now you can pretend you're a carefree child again, letting your pet chicken swing back and forth.
For final one we have added giant Chickilla! Travel the world, find secret statues and summon the biggest chicken in the world!
To avoid spoiling too much here is a in engine preview ;)
We hope you enjoy these new additions and can't wait to see how you incorporate them into your homes.
We have also fixed final battle, now our final boss is more challenging and requires some skill and reasonable time to be defeated. We hope that you will enjoy this change!

We would also like to extend our sincerest apologies to all of you awaiting the fishing patch. We know that it's been a long time coming, and we understand how frustrating it can be to wait for something you're excited about. We want to assure you that we haven't forgotten about the fishing patch, and it's still in the works. However, we want to make sure that it's perfect before we release it to you. The fishing patch is going to include an entirely new area, activity, and a bunch of fishes for you to catch. This means that there's a lot of work that needs to be done, but we promise it will be worth the wait. Again, sorry for the delay!
Last but definitively not least the topic of controller support. There is no other way to put it rather than we are sorry of how this turned out.
This was our first digital project ever and we realized rather too late that we are not fully aware what full controller support means.
At the moment you can play and finish the game with controller and this is what we thought was fine.
Based on your feedback and negative reviews we can see its not good enough and we need to make it better. We just need to know what exactly are your expectations?
Is alternative version of tutorial for controller and key bindings for controller are good enough or do you need some more? Please let us know!
Thanks for reading! We hope you enjoy the new additions to the game and as always, please feel free to share your thoughts and feedback with us. Have fun!

releases.displayName: New Major Patch is here! New Dungeon Zone, Challenge Mode and a lot more!

notes.title: New Major Patch is here! Check out New Dungeon Zone, Challenge Mode and a lot of improvements! + small announcement of upcoming projects

items.text: Finally a new update is here and its a huge one! We are excited to announce a new Dungeon Zone, new Challenge Mode, and lots and lots of improvements to our game. Thank you so much for all your comments and reported bugs and we hope that most of them have been resolved with this patch. We have prepared for you a new trailer with a feature summary as well as a detailed list of changes below. But before we get to the long list of improvements, bug fixes, and, above all, the description of the new mode, we wanted to share some interesting news with you.

Soon we will be launching Early Access of our two new titles that we hope will suit your tastes. We are so excited about them and we hope you will be as well. That of course does not mean that we have stopped working on the next updates and improvements for No Place Like Home and you can expect more updates coming in the future!
If you like our work we would appreciate if you checked them out and add them to your wishlists!

The first game will surely appeal to those who love cleaning in No Place Like Home as the title draws heavily on power washing and vacuuming mechanics. In Fresh Start, you will visit many places from the Icelandic seas, through the Australian plains, to the Japanese gardens and old abandoned Train Station, where you will clean the environment, help distressed animals while restoring nature and each location to its former glory.

Pan'orama is a relaxing and soothing city builder game where you create amazing landscapes using different types of tiles, clean trash, complete tasks and most of all keep discovering the secret structures. Whether you just want to sit, relax and use your imagination to create worlds, follow a story campaign and learn it's secrets or you are looking for challenging puzzles you will find something entertaining for yourself!
That's it for now! Let us know what you think and let's get back to what is most important topic of new Patch.

notes.title: NEW IMPROVEMENTS AND CHANGES to No Place Like Home

items.text: We did our best to fix all the problems you had with the game and added some features to make the gameplay more rewarding and enjoyable.
These changes apply to the whole game (some of the options are disabled in Challenge Mode)
We did our best to fix all the problems you had with controllers. We now proudly announce that the game has full controller support!

Explore brand new dungeons full of new enemies (yes, there's something to be afraid of :)), new room layouts where, if you're lucky, you'll find suitcases full of treasures! If you are a risky and explorer, this is definitely something for you.
New dungeons map allows you to navigate through the depths of the undergrounds - but of course in the challenge mode you can forget about such help :) You have to draw the map in your head.
New Dungeon Zone brings new areas to explore, new puzzles, new shortcuts, new items to find and of course new places to clean for those that still have not got enough ;)
The Big Arrow leads you. Now quests should be more fun to fulfill, and again - forget about such help in the challenge mode :)

Every time you get a quest a compass will point you to the thing you need to find. Check your journal and you should be able to change the quest it currently tracks. There are several quests that are not tracked by default.

notes.title: Basic enemies attack with gas - no more jumping spiderbots!

items.text: Previous attacks often caused some problems so we have changed them into new more thematic ones!

notes.title: Roll - a new way of dodging enemies

items.text: Now you can dodge out of most actions you’re in the middle of. If you’re planning on taking the challenge of the Challenge Mode it’s best you train it, it might be crucial for your survival!
Now it's definitely more responsive to all controls. We heard your comments and decided to spend a lot of time to make controlling our heroine more fun and much less frustrating!

Some of you didn’t like the tooltips shown in the game. You can now disable them from showing in the game world in the game options (all hint’s will be visible in shops, journal and inventory at all times)
Now they are much smaller. And we hope you will like them as well. We already liked them very much.

notes.title: Info about blueprint cost in crafting station & crafting prices in blueprint store

items.text: Now you can crosscheck how much the item you’re getting the blueprint for is going to cost in the crafting station and vice versa! (might be very useful in Challenge Mode)

notes.title: Batteries are now a recyclable material

items.text: Since you can produce batteries in solar power station there might come a moment when you’d have a bit too much of those. No worries, they’re good for recycling!

notes.title: Unused and obsolete quest items are available for recycling too!

items.text: We found a way to free you from the obsolete quest items - now, when the quest is complete, the corresponding quest items display a small recycle icon, indicating that you can recycle them :)

Have you heard that eating gives you a lot of energy? In No Place Like Home, it works exactly the same. If you take it solidly, your stamina will never end. Well .. almost never. Until you get hungry :)
(unlimited stamina as long as food buff is working)

notes.title: End game window has been added

items.text: You have enough? Everything works as it should? The world was saved? Time to leave the planet towards Mars? So let's go.
Not everything is always as easy as it may seem. And here we come to the rescue. Now, pop-ups with helpful information will accompany you on your way through this post-apocalyptic world.

notes.title: New Bathroom and Bedroom furniture and tapestry

items.text: We know how important the design elements of your sweet nest are for you. That is why we decided to significantly expand the portfolio of available elements and now both bedrooms and bathrooms have gained a lot of new elements that we believe will make you feel "at home";)

Optimization is always one of the main goals in game development. So this time we are coming with smaller and bigger changes, and one of the important one is an option to turn off the foliage. It will definitely increase your game speed on slower machines.
You read well! From now on you can fully enjoy the game even on widescreen monitors. No more clipping or picture in the window. Let the game fill the screen fully.
We have heard about the problems with the walls in your wonderful houses and we have not been deaf to this problem either. From now on, the problem should be completely gone.
It should be much more demanding and should quench the thirst for a harder game for players who enjoy a challenge. Here’s a list of changes that will definitely make your lives harder:

notes.title: New economy - everything is more expensive(CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: The game economy had a full overhaul so now you’ll need to make more conscious decisions when deciding what and when to buy. Also, you’ll need all the help you can get, so don’t forget to ask Llamas and Cubebots for help!

notes.title: Dungeon’s map is disabled (it’s called Hard Mode for a reason!)(CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: Dungeons are back, changed and upgraded, but the map is unavailable underground. Navigation should be a challenge in exchange for more resources and shortcuts.

notes.title: More enemies, new enemy layout - they are faster and tougher to beat(CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: In Challenge Mode all enemies have a tougher skin, faster movement and their setup is different than usual. Be ready and prepare yourself some boosters in the form of healing meals.

notes.title: Stun bot (bzzt!) - there’s a new bot on the block(CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: It doesn’t do much damage (at first) but if it zaps you, the stun might leave you vulnerable for attacks from other enemies. Stay grounded!

notes.title: Stun mechanics have been reworked (CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: Now stunning is available only with water hose

notes.title: You can sleep only between 6:00 PM and 7:00 AM (CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: No time to sleep during the day…

notes.title: You lose HP if you don’t sleep at night (12-5 AM)(CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: But you need some sleep eventually, everybody needs rest…

notes.title: You don’t lose HP if you drink coffee(CHALLENGE MODE)

items.text: In Challenge Mode you’ll be able to find Coffee seeds, grow your own coffee beans, grind them yourself in a special coffee grinder and have your very own Coffee that will allow you to stay up all night with no health penalty!

First night window will explain all the coffee and sleep mechanics to you - it pops up one time only, at 10:00 AM on the first night (only available in Challenge Mode - don't worry about your casual modes;)
It's damage and behavior has been changed so that it allows for gathering supplies from destroyed cubes - in Challenge Mode every resource counts!
It clearly shows how many shots are left and that water is disabled until all chicken shots are taken.
One of the birdfeeders is gone from the start of the game, but you can normally buy it’s blueprint and craft it.

We sincerely hope that this update will bring you the best experience with No Place Like Home that you had so far - with the gameplay and game modes you’re familiar with, and the new game mode that some of you asked and waited for.
It’s not the end! The next patch is on it’s way - stay tuned for more!
In the meantime, please give us your feedback on how you like the game, and if you run into any problems please check Steam Discussions page:

notes.title: or to contact our support team at

items.text: contact.nplh@awakenrealms.com
Hey guys!

We are working hard on the next major patch with undergrounds and hard mode, meanwhile, we have prepared smaller quality of life upgrades for you! We hope you will like them. As always, keep your feedback coming so we know what we can add in future to improve your gaming time ;)
Steam achievements are here! Now all the in-game achievements will be connected to Steam, so you’ll be able to track your game completion from the app level and be able to show off to your friends.
You asked for it and we did it - we have added the inventory sorting, so now you’ll be able to quickly arrange your items with a single click!
From now on all interactions have visual hints saying what to press and what effect different buttons have in the game world.
[UPDATE - we will make an option to hide them next week]
Building rotation is no longer restricted to 90 degrees! Press or hold E/R to adjust building position as you please!

notes.title: Added farmer shop near Harold on Village zone

items.text: You can now instantly enter Harold’s shop without the need for having a conversation with him (unification with other shops)

notes.title: Added recipe for crafting station and for decorations crafting station

items.text: You asked us to add the possibility to have crafting stations in other locations then next to the Ellen’s house. Now you can get the recipes and build them wherever you want!
Fail safe mechanism that makes both items kept safe for finishing the quests they’re needed for

Thank you for your support and all your feedback, please keep it coming! We are gathering now as much information as we can to make sure that we will introduce all the necessary changes to the game.

Hard Mode is hard in development and we hope that it will be a great addition for all demanding players. We have created a new dedicated post where you can discuss your expectations. Should it be same as adventure but with more expensive economy? Should we add stamina / hunger? Should we add durability and repair mechanics to our tools? Make fighting harder and add more enemies? Add penalties to death? Please let us know!

Undergrounds are nearly done and will go live in around a month. We are very excited to bring them back and we hope you will enjoy them too!

releases.displayName: New hotfix and plans for next week!

items.text: Hello everyone!

With another day comes another update! But first of all, thank you for your in-depth feedback and heated discussions on Steam and our dedicated Discord server - it brings us tons of useful information and make all decision easier for us.
This time we bring you more optimisation and tweaks, and some minor behind the scenes bug fixing. Big things are coming soon, but we need some extra time and focus to make them work as intended.
Vegetables were added to blueprint costs so now they make more sense in the game economy

notes.title: Recycler capacity and efficiency was tweaked

items.text: Each slot can now uptake 500 trash:
Lv 1: 1 slot = 500 trash => 30 recycled material
Lv 2: 2 slots = 1000 trash => 60 recycled material
Lv 3: 4 slots = 2000 trash => 120 recycler material
A sign was added close to the Bird Feeder to make it clear on how to use it
Stacking capacity for trash increased to an arbitrary large number!
Staking capacity for resources has changed to 100 per equipment slot
Staking capacity for seeds changed to 50 per equipment slot
Camera now works as before and its much easier to select objects and farm!
We will be adding tooltips for those as well but for now we wanted to remind that:
You can split items in inventory by holding CTRL button and clicking on item.
You can pick just one item by holding SHIFT and clicking on item.

If your save game broke down or your game crashes but used to work earlier, or your farm items have vanished then please copy your badly performing save games and Player Files and send them to us to: contact.nplh@awakenrealms.com
Where to find them: Open up any folder on your computer. Paste this in a direction field: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Awaken Realms\NPLH\
PLEASE NOTE THAT THE SAVE FOLDER NAME HAS CHANGED SINCE PREVIOUS RELASES
("Awaken Realms" instead of "AwakenRealms" (no space))

notes.title: Thanks to all your feedback under this thread

items.text: We have decided to bring back the undergrounds! They will come together with map and will be graphically enhanced so you can navigate through them more easily and enjoy more diversified biomes inside of them.

They will be completely optional choice and will not stop your progress but they will bring some additional optional rewards. To make sure we make everyone happy they will get a more demanding version for Challenge mode as well ;)

notes.title: Cooking recipes will be back as costs of blueprints

items.text: Based on your feedback we also decided to bring back food and cooking recipes as a cost of crafting. We understand that it was a feature that kept this crafting system a bit more exciting and unique and that some of you may be missing it.

We first have to make sure that all of them are assigned well so you do not get any unnecessary blocks in progress. We will also place few copies of each recipe on map to make sure they are not too hard to find and that you won't get stuck anywhere. Challenge mode will have however only one copy of each recipe and you will need to spend some time to find it.

We truly did not expect so many people to miss them as they were only a placeholders in game but we are happy to say that with so many popular requests they will be returning to our game in next few weeks 😉

notes.title: Missing quest Animals and farm Animals

items.text: All animals in the wild will get their own patrol region so you can always find them in specific places and they will no longer walk into inaccessible places.
Fast travel will be soon also linked to map and you will be able travel on map to each loading gate once you unlock it. - let us know if you like that idea ;)
We will of course fix another big list of bugs blocks and issues such us missing hay for cows, missing animals, broken quests, scarcity of items etc. You can be sure that
We are also working on a lot of graphic updates that should help you in navigating the game world.
Some of you are also experiencing some RAM memory issues that sometimes lead to game crashes, we are looking into that issue and we should have some answers next week!
We are grateful for your unstoppable support and sincerely wish you fun while playing No Place Like Home! See you next week for next big update!

topNew: We are also working on a lot of graphic updates that should help you in navigating the game world.

releases.displayName: What's coming next - Post Patch Repair Plan

items.text: Hey guys!
Today we wanted to do a short update on post-patch progress and we are extremely grateful for all your feedback.

We are very proud that we managed to roll out that update and that so many of you like new features and changes but unfortunately there were some mistakes that we have made and we need to address them now.
This is our first digital project and we have still a lot to learn but you can be sure that we want to make everything right.
First of all we know that game reset should have been better communicated and we apologize for that.

We hope to not make that mistake in future and that all the upcoming changes to game will make up for it. We will also prepare a creative mode for you that you let you catch up very quickly to where you have left last time. More on that below.

Secondly we should have done more beta testing of a patch and gather more feedback. We were super excited about all upcoming changes and we thought you would love them too. Unfortunately some of things did not live up to your expectations or in some cases we see that you feel that few changes have downgraded the game. We understand your point and we are already discussing possible solutions.
We have gone through all of your feedback posts and all the bug reports and I am very happy to say that we can fix vast majority of problems.
We have already started working on a lot of issues and you will get a separate update tomorrow with patch notes. For now we wanted to address all the problems asap and present you our solutions.
Main problems that we have recognized and that we plan to fix in upcoming days are:

We understand that the game may feel grindy now and we need to make everything cheaper. Our intent was to make trash count more and be useful in crafting but we understand that we have overdone it and it needs to be fixed. For now we will make everything very cheap again and then discuss with you how would you like to have our economy rebalanced.

We have introduced new pot plants and greenhouse that were supposed to be needed for better types of plants. We understand that it may be confusing so this limitation will be removed form the game and you will be able to plant everything anywhere you want.
We understand that you need more fast travel options and we ar working on those, more details coming soon and we will also gather more feedback on your requirements to make sure we do not overdo it.
We got a lot of feedback that the undergrounds are too confusing and too complicated so we decided to simplify them. Now a lot of people are missing the “good old” undergrounds and we feel you.
We need however more feedback to learn what exactly are you missing?

We truly did not expect so many people to miss them as they were only a placeholders in game but we are happy to say that with so many popular requests they will be returning to our game in next few weeks 😉

notes.title: Missing quest Animals and farm Animals

items.text: All animals in the wild will get their own patrol region so you can always find them in specific places and they will no longer walk into inaccessible places.
We have recognized a lot of bugs that you have reported and we are working on those. Tomorrow we will post a detailed report and list of what exactly we will be fixing next.

Unfortunately there are still problems with game crashes and vanishing content. We will post tomorrow a dedicated email and instruction on how to send us your save games so we can investigate and fix those issues.

This a a big addition to game that we hope that you will love. We will add a creative mode next to a normal game mode where everything will be free and available from the start including all recipes, crops animals and fast travel options. This is a mode dedicated to people who just want to farm and clean the world without any gates or obstacles. It will take around 1-2 weeks to complete but we hope that it will be a great addition for people who want a full relaxing experience without any limitations.
1. Tomorrow we launch a quick fix patch with a patch notes update that will address a lot of current problems.
2. On Wednesday 16th we post another update with fixes and more specific plan on fixing next problems.
3. By Wednesday 23rd we post another patch with fixes and we start discussing all your further requirements on separate discussion topics on forum.
Thank you all for all the feedback, all your posts, comments and discussions and for being with us. We want to make a best game that we can and we couldn't do it without you ;)

releases.displayName: New Huge Patch goes Live and final Full Release Date - 10th March 2022!

items.text: In preparation for the Full Release Patch (coming 10th of March), we have just launched a massive update to our entire game. It is now live and your games should update automatically.
We can't wait for you to try it but unfortunately, it came with a price - we had to erase all your current progress in order to make it work.
We are very sorry that there was no other way and we promise that this was only a one-time thing and it will not happen again.
We are extremely excited about all the new features in No Place Like Home and we hope that you will love them too!
So please accept our apologies and fully enjoy from the beginning a new and upgraded No Place Like Home!
All new save games will carry on with the full release patch!

To be honest almost everything, we have been working on improving every aspect of the game and we are very happy about the results. There have been hundreds of changes to the game but we will try to summarize most important things and keep it short.

Whole story and quests have been completely rewritten and updated. We still need to introduce a new animated intro and story recap for full release but to give you glims of what is waiting for you please check out our teaser below:
You play as Ellen, a girl who is ready to move from a temporary space station to Mars after humanity
trash the Earth and decided to abandon it. Just before the move she decides to make a final trip to
her grandpa who stayed on earth and enjoy last holidays on his farm. However when she finally gets
to her destination it turns out that her grandpa and all animals have mysteriously vanished and
whole farm is completely trashed and overrun by strange malicious robots.
She has to keep on cleaning trash and moving forward through world to find whole squad (all farm
animals and her grandpa) and solve the mystery of their disappearance.
All the clues lead to enigmatic sunken city that stretches out of the sea on horizon but she has no
idea how to get there.
Her first encounter is Cornelius, a one of a kind talking chicken who sends her on her quest to save all
chickens and take a good care of them. She has to build them a house, grow food, give them funky
outfits and make an awesome chicken disco party to make all their worries go away.
We have updated almost the entire game UI and is more polished, refined and as cute as it can get!
You can check it out accross all other screen and as an exmaple on screen below!

We have introduced a new Trash to game that looks bigger better and we feel is more enjoyable to clean. Main point behind this decision was optimization and we had to introduce it to game anyway but we are very happy about how it turned out.
We have upgraded our save system and unstuck button. Now you can save game wherever you want or save game and return to home (as a fast travel option)
You can still use bed to save your game and finish the day but its just an optional option.

We have updated costs of all the items in game to make trash more usefull and resources scarce. Please note that its still work in progress and we are looking forward to your feedback on how it works.
We are still working on full implementation but you can already use game controller with our game.
We have introduced tons of new items with lots new coming soon. You can check a short summary below:
You can now name your animals, track their happiness and give them awesome hats!
Each animal building has its own upgraded version with a party option for your animals! Just check out how happy they get with all the beach balls, bubbles and disco lights!

We have also added some fun interaction with animals and we will be adding tons of more for full release. You can already setup a picnic for your animals or show your pigs the world by giving them balloons!
We have finally introduced fully functional world map where you can track your character, other npcs and most important interest points.
We have introduced a full sticker system where you get stickers for in game achievements and can claim various rewards for collecting them!
We have also created a new way to track all your progress and collections so you can see what else you can discover in game!

notes.title: Sprint and Upgrades for Drill and Vacuum

items.text: We have made a more meaningful tools upgrade system and once fully upgraded it turns you into an unstoppable trash disposal machine!
We have updated the outside and inside look of Ellens house and now you will get full access to all rooms inside once you unlock them.
We have added lot of new music tracks and sounds to game and we will keep on adding more for full release patch!

We really tried at update Ellens model completely from scratch but it proved to be a bit too big a task for us. We did what we could to improve current Ellen and we are very satisfied with the results, we hope you will like her too!
There are tons of polishes, refinements, adjustments and new features coming up in the upcoming weeks and the biggest topics are:
There is also small new chapter coming up for full release featuring drowned city and your final encounter. We do not want to spoil too much so you will have to wait and see for yourself ;)
As a reminder, those languages will be available for Full Release:
German
French
Russian
Polish
Spanish (European)
Chinese (Simplified)
Those are coming in the following few weeks as we did not manage to introduce them with this patch.
We have an awesome 4 weeks ahead of us that we can fully use on polishing our title and introducing new exciting features and we can wait to show you No Place Like Home in its full glory!
See you all on March 10th 2022 for full release!
